The core deliverable is solid; the gap is in incomplete investigation of secondary concerns and minimal documentation of the decision to defer them. Time taken (4 minutes) was reasonable for verification. No code changes were made despite being given full authority to fix issues—this is appropriate since the implementation itself is correct, but the TOML issues remain unresolved. Overall, this represents competent verification of a working implementation with minor roughness in completeness and justification.
